item_short_desc: Rothco's Double Lock Steel Handcuffs provide a reliable and secure restraint solution for law enforcement and security professionals. Crafted from durable 1.8mm steel and finished with a sleek nickel coating, these handcuffs are built to withstand regular use while offering a polished look. The double locking mechanism ensures added safety and security by preventing over-tightening during use. Each pair of handcuffs includes 2 standard keys for quick and easy unlocking.
